prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: wide website hero splash illustration for The Skills Library, a practical public collection of reusable AI workflows, part of The Prompt Library by Miguel Guhlin.
Primary request: an inviting, beautifully crafted editorial illustration of an everyday person's idea becoming a reusable set of skills. A bright physical workbench with an open notebook at center, six richly illustrated paper workflow cards arranged naturally around it: a magnifying glass and source page, a checked checklist, a pen editing a paragraph, a balanced comparison of two options, a small learning path and book, and two conversation bubbles. A hand places a useful card into a small open library box, making the reusable workflow concept tangible. The objects feel like real tactile paper and clever miniature tools, not software screenshots.
Style/medium: polished dimensional paper-cut illustration with subtle realistic paper grain and soft studio shadows, sophisticated and approachable for adults. Crisp, memorable forms, strong visual hierarchy, generous breathing room.
Composition: panoramic landscape, about 2:1; main scene centered and fully visible, safe margins at every edge, suitable to display above or beside a website heading. No title baked into the image because the website heading is live HTML.
Palette: deep navy #102A54, slate blue #2F5F8F, sky blue #8FB8E8, white and cool pale blue #F7F9FC, small warm golden highlights. Bright natural background.
Constraints: no readable words, letters, numbers, brand logos, watermark, robots, brains, glowing circuitry, space scenes, or generic magic sparkles. Visual warmth comes from tactile craft and everyday usefulness.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: compact tasteful website splash image for The Prompt Library, a practical public library of AI prompts for educators, writers and everyday knowledge work.
Primary request: a beautifully understated editorial still life: a small open navy notebook, a sharpened pencil, three loose white prompt cards with abstract nonverbal lines, and a single blue folded paper speech bubble. The idea is a good question becoming a useful piece of work. No words or readable lettering.
Style: refined dimensional paper-cut and tactile editorial illustration, delicate paper grain and soft natural shadows. Calm, thoughtful, adult, visually uncluttered. A few carefully composed objects, plenty of clean background.
Composition: wide landscape approximately 2:1, central objects fully visible with generous safe space around them; usable at a small size in an existing website header. The image will be displayed around 320 pixels wide, so keep forms simple and clear.
Palette: deep navy #102A54, slate blue #2F5F8F, sky blue #8FB8E8, white, cool pale blue #F7F9FC, a very small warm golden pencil accent. Bright background.
Constraints: no text, letters, logos, watermark, robots, brains, circuits, glitter, decorative sparkles, or large dramatic effects. Nothing busy or grandiose.
